name: EasyPost
label: EasyPost v2 — address, parcel, shipment, buy, tracker
description: EasyPost REST v2. HTTP Basic with api_key as username and empty password (auth.basicKeyPosition=username). Docs: https://www.easypost.com/docs/api
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One official API operation. Secrets stay in configurationParameters.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Official API verb. EXACT: address_create | parcel_create | shipment_create | buy | tracker_create | trigger. Blank uses configurationParameters.operation. trigger is ingress (BPMN message event), not an HTTP call.

schema.label: id
schema.description: Shipment id for buy. Path {id}. Example: shp_...

schema.label: street1
schema.description: Address line 1 for address_create. Nested to address.street1. Example: 417 Montgomery Street.

schema.label: street2
schema.description: Address line 2 for address_create. Nested to address.street2.

schema.label: city
schema.description: City for address_create. Nested to address.city. Example: San Francisco.

schema.label: state
schema.description: State / province for address_create. Nested to address.state. Example: CA.

schema.label: zip
schema.description: Postal code for address_create. Nested to address.zip. Example: 94104.

schema.label: country
schema.description: ISO country for address_create. Nested to address.country. Example: US.

schema.label: name
schema.description: Person name for address_create. Nested to address.name.

schema.label: company
schema.description: Company for address_create. Nested to address.company.

schema.label: phone
schema.description: Phone for address_create. Nested to address.phone.

schema.label: email
schema.description: Email for address_create. Nested to address.email.

schema.label: verify
schema.description: Verification types for address_create, e.g. ["delivery"]. Nested to address.verify.

schema.label: length
schema.description: Parcel length (inches) for parcel_create. Nested to parcel.length. Example: 20.2.

schema.label: width
schema.description: Parcel width (inches) for parcel_create. Nested to parcel.width.

schema.label: height
schema.description: Parcel height (inches) for parcel_create. Nested to parcel.height.

schema.label: weight
schema.description: Parcel weight in ounces (required for parcel_create). Nested to parcel.weight. Example: 65.9.

schema.label: predefined_package
schema.description: EasyPost predefined_package instead of LxWxH. Nested to parcel.predefined_package. Example: Letter.

schema.label: parcel
schema.description: Full Parcel object. parcel_create escape hatch, or shipment_create parcel (id or inline). Nested to shipment.parcel on shipment_create.

schema.label: to_address
schema.description: Destination Address id or inline object for shipment_create. Nested to shipment.to_address.

schema.label: from_address
schema.description: Origin Address id or inline object for shipment_create. Nested to shipment.from_address.

schema.label: return_address
schema.description: Optional return Address for shipment_create. Nested to shipment.return_address.

schema.label: customs_info
schema.description: CustomsInfo for international shipment_create. Nested to shipment.customs_info.

schema.label: carrier_accounts
schema.description: Carrier account ids to rate on shipment_create. Nested to shipment.carrier_accounts.

schema.label: is_return
schema.description: When true, shipment_create is a return shipment.

schema.label: rate
schema.description: Rate to purchase on buy: {"id":"rate_..."}. Official buy body.rate.

schema.label: insurance
schema.description: Insurance amount in USD for buy. Example: 249.99.

schema.label: tracking_code
schema.description: Carrier tracking code for tracker_create. Nested to tracker.tracking_code. Example: EZ1000000001.

schema.label: carrier
schema.description: Optional carrier override for tracker_create. Nested to tracker.carrier. Example: USPS.

ports.name: output
ports.description: status=ok + data on 2xx. Secrets never present. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Exact ok on HTTP 2xx.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Provider HTTP status. Never includes secrets.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body. May contain order PII — do not log values.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: HTTP verb for OfficialApiNode. EXACT: address_create | parcel_create | shipment_create | buy | tracker_create | trigger. trigger does not open a socket.

configurationParameters.label: Api Key
configurationParameters.description: EasyPost API key. HTTP Basic username with empty password (auth.basicKeyPosition=username). Never log. Customer owns the merchant account.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout seconds (connect + read). <=0 uses api_spec defaultTimeout.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.
